name: Claim-Decomposition Verification Pass
description: Take a FINISHED document - a report, an audit finding set, any agent's completion claim - decompose it into atomic claims, re-probe each with a MECHANICALLY DIFFERENT instrument, and emit a per-claim CONFIRMED / REFUTED / UNRESOLVED ledger. The verdict is computed by a deterministic SCRIPT, not by a model, and the script's signature rule closes the measured hole in the source implementation: a CONFIRMED or REFUTED claim whose `source_probe` is empty is a VIOLATION, never 'independent'. SHADOW and BLOCKING are both wired: `mode` selects which gate stage runs, so promoting the gate is a parameter change, not a rewrite.

instrument_registry.description: Allowlist of verifier instruments. A required-but-missing registry makes every claim UNRESOLVED - it never degrades to CONFIRMED.

mode.description: shadow = log and continue; blocking = a violation stops the caller

cross_vendor_top_n.description: How many load-bearing claims also get a cross-vendor verifier; 0 disables the pass

max_claims.description: Cap on atomic claims decomposed from one document

decomposer.description: Splits the document into atomic, independently checkable claims; adds no claim the document does not make

instrument-assigner.description: Assigns each claim a verifier whose MECHANISM differs from the claim's own source probe; may not assign the source probe back

claim-verifier.description: Re-probes ONE claim with its assigned instrument and never sees another verifier's verdict

cross-vendor-verifier.description: Second verifier from a different vendor for the load-bearing claims, because a same-vendor verifier shares the author's blind spots

gate-runner.description: Runs the deterministic gate script; has judge authority precisely because it exercises no judgement

routes.reason: the verdict must be computed, not judged - routing the gate to a model would reintroduce the failure it exists to catch

source-probe-required.expression: confirmed_claims_without_source_probe == 0 AND refuted_claims_without_source_probe == 0 AND same_probe_rerun_claims == 0 AND unresolved_claims_promoted_to_confirmed == 0

source-probe-required-shadow.expression: confirmed_claims_without_source_probe == 0 AND refuted_claims_without_source_probe == 0 AND same_probe_rerun_claims == 0 AND unresolved_claims_promoted_to_confirmed == 0

stages.title: Decompose the finished document into atomic claims

work_unit.title: Split the document into atomic claims, each with the source probe the document itself cites
work_unit.question_or_target: Decompose the document into atomic claims. For each claim record the SOURCE PROBE the document offers for it - the measurement that produced it - or record that the document offers none. Add no claim the document does not make.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each claim carries the document offset or heading it came from, plus the source_probe text or an explicit null
tests_required: a document sentence carrying two independent assertions must yield two claims, not one compound claim
both-states: a claim whose document offers NO probe must record source_probe null, and an adjacent claim with a probe must record it
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the instrument assigner rejects any claim that is not independently checkable and returns it for re-splitting
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0401 emitted only when the claim file exists, parses, and every claim has an anchor into the document plus a source_probe field that is present or explicitly null; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0401 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two rejected decompositions, enumerate at least two alternative splitting strategies

stages.title: Assign a mechanically different instrument per claim

work_unit.title: Map each claim to a verifier instrument whose mechanism differs from its source probe
work_unit.question_or_target: For each claim pick a verifier from the instrument registry whose mechanism differs from the claim's source probe - a different shell, a different data field, a different measurement. Record WHY it differs. If no different instrument exists, mark the claim NO-INDEPENDENT-INSTRUMENT.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each row carries source_probe fingerprint, verifier fingerprint, and the one-line reason the two mechanisms differ
tests_required: a claim whose only available instrument equals its source probe must be marked NO-INDEPENDENT-INSTRUMENT, never assigned that instrument
a missing instrument registry must make the stage FAIL rather than assign a default instrument
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the gate script independently recomputes both fingerprints and flags same-probe-rerun regardless of what this stage claimed
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0402 emitted only when every claim has an assignment row with two distinct mechanism fingerprints, or an explicit NO-INDEPENDENT-INSTRUMENT marker; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0402 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: fixed backoff, at most 2 attempts; a second failure marks the affected claims NO-INDEPENDENT-INSTRUMENT

stages.title: Re-probe every claim in parallel, each with its own instrument

body.title: Re-probe one claim with its assigned instrument

work_unit.title: Run the assigned instrument and emit one verdict with its verifier probe recorded
work_unit.question_or_target: Run the assigned instrument against the claim and emit exactly one verdict: CONFIRMED, REFUTED or UNRESOLVED. Record the verifier probe verbatim. An unavailable instrument yields UNRESOLVED naming the missing instrument - never CONFIRMED.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: substantive subagents default to Opus (performance rule: quality over cost)

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the verdict row carries the verifier probe verbatim, its raw output, and an anchor (file:line, command output, or URL)
tests_required: an unavailable instrument must yield UNRESOLVED naming the instrument (both-states: the same claim with the instrument present must yield a real verdict)
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: no verifier sees another verifier's verdict; the reconciliation is the gate script's job
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0403 emitted only when exactly one verdict row exists for the claim, carrying a verifier probe and an anchor; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0403 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two instrument failures return UNRESOLVED with the failure recorded

stages.title: Cross-vendor second verifier on the load-bearing claims

work_unit.title: Independently re-probe the top-N load-bearing claims from a different vendor
work_unit.question_or_target: For the N most load-bearing claims, re-probe from a different vendor with no sight of the in-vendor verdict, and record agreement or disagreement as an independence measurement.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: cross-vendor independence: a same-vendor verifier shares the author's blind spots

work_unit.evidence_requirement: per claim: the second-vendor probe, its output, and whether it agrees; a severed dispatch is recorded as NOT-CHECKED, never as agreement
tests_required: a killed dispatch must produce NOT-CHECKED, never silence and never an inferred agreement
a result string containing a background receipt must be rejected outright rather than parsed as a verdict
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the gate script treats a NOT-CHECKED cross-vendor row as absent evidence, not as corroboration
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0404 emitted only when each selected claim has a second-vendor row carrying a probe, an output and an agreement flag or NOT-CHECKED; otherwise FAILED:BPR-0404 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two severed dispatches record NOT-CHECKED and stop retrying

stages.title: SHADOW mode: run the deterministic gate, log the violations, do not block
BLOCKING mode: a violation stops the caller
Emit the per-claim ledger and the violation list

work_unit.title: Compute the ledger deterministically: verdicts, violations, ok flag
work_unit.question_or_target: Reduce the verdicts to one ledger: per claim the verdict, source_probe, verifier_probe, independence flag and anchor; plus the violation list and an ok flag. A CONFIRMED or REFUTED verdict with an empty source_probe is a violation - the exact case the source implementation's own 30-test regression did not cover.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a deterministic reducer: model judgement here is what produced the defect being fixed

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the ledger is produced by a script whose exit code and stdout are recorded; ok is computed from the violation list, never asserted
tests_required: MANDATORY both-states: a ledger input with a CONFIRMED claim carrying an EMPTY source_probe must produce a violation and ok=false; filling that one field must flip ok to true with everything else unchanged
identical source and verifier fingerprints must produce a same-probe-rerun violation
a clean input must produce violations == [] - the gate must be able to pass, or it is a permanent red light
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the gate is deterministic, so review targets the SCRIPT and its both-states battery rather than the verdict
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BPR-0405 emitted only when the ledger exists, parses, every claim has exactly one verdict, and ok equals (violations == []); otherwise FAILED:BPR-0405 <failure-class> <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none: a deterministic reducer over unchanged inputs cannot produce a different result

impact.blast_radius: read-only over the document; writes only under command-center/verification/bp-res-04/**

derived_from.credit: measured defect: _validate() at :132-156 does not require source_probe

contraindications: NOT a substitute for running the code - that is a test blueprint
NOT for creative or subjective output where `claim` is undefined
do NOT run it on its own output: a gate verifying itself is a single signal
x_extensions.the_repaired_defect: The source implementation's _validate() requires an id, text and a recognised verdict but NOT source_probe, so an absent source normalises to empty strings that any non-empty verifier trivially differs from - and the same-probe-rerun check cannot fire. Its shipped 30-test regression passes because its missing-probe case omits the VERIFIER, not the SOURCE. The mandatory both-states test on BPR-0405 is that missing case.
x_extensions.owner_decision: Ship the claim gate SHADOW-only, or let it block once its both-states battery is green? Both paths are wired; `mode` selects.
unverified: UNVERIFIED that closing the hole changes a real verdict within a month; settling experiment = run the gate in shadow over the next 20 completion claims and count how many carry a CONFIRMED verdict with no source probe.

worked_example.name: gate a finished audit report in shadow mode
acceptance: a CONFIRMED claim with an empty source_probe appears in violations[] and ok is false
a claim whose verifier fingerprint equals its source fingerprint is flagged same-probe-rerun

stopping_rule_controls.why: the floor stops the rule firing vacuously on a document that decomposed into nothing
an empty instrument registry must escalate rather than pass
